remarks: Modern 2-Bed/2-Bath Condo for Rent at Eastside Commons - Downtown Stamford  Welcome to Eastside Commons, one of Stamford's most sought-after condo communities just minutes from downtown! This spacious and modern 2-bedroom, 2-bath unit offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience.  Inside, you'll find a beautifully updated kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and rich dark wood cabinetry-perfect for cooking and entertaining. The open-concept living area leads to oversized windows overlooking a serene courtyard with BBQ grills and a peaceful seating area.  Additional highlights include:  Full-size in-unit washer and dryer  Two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space  Two full bathrooms  One reserved parking space included  Pet-friendly (case-by-case basis)  Eastside Commons is a professionally managed building offering residents top-tier amenities including a concierge, fitness center, and community room.  Don't miss your chance to live in this well-maintained, amenity-rich building close to Stamford's restaurants, shopping, and transportation.
